description: The bar chart illustrates the performance, measured as accuracy in percentage, of various reinforcement learning (RL) methods—both with and without self-reflection—across three multimodal reasoning benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents Accuracy (%) ranging from 50 to 62, with tick marks at 2% intervals. The horizontal axis categorizes the three datasets. Six distinct methods are compared, each represented by a uniquely colored and patterned bar: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue-gray), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green), as indicated in the legend. In Mathverse, DAPO+Self-reflection achieves ~56.1%, DAPO ~53.1%, SRPO ~55.8%, GRPO ~53.5%, PPO+Self-reflection ~54.5%, and PPO ~53.3%. In MMLU, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches ~57.0%, DAPO ~55.9%, SRPO ~57.2%, GRPO ~55.8%, PPO+Self-reflection ~56.2%, and PPO ~54.6%. In Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection peaks at ~61.0%, DAPO ~57.6%, SRPO ~60.6%, GRPO ~58.1%, PPO+Self-reflection ~59.1%, and PPO ~57.0%. Across all datasets, DAPO+Self-reflection consistently shows the highest accuracy, followed closely by SRPO, while PPO without self-reflection consistently underperforms. The chart visually emphasizes the performance boost conferred by self-reflection, particularly in Physics, where the gap between self-reflection and non-self-reflection variants is most pronounced.
